name: Takka Sushi Bar & Grill
notes: Work list gave foodeist.com, an aggregator/directory page with no priced menu (only a price-tier symbol, no dish prices, no server-rendered menu data). No independent restaurant-owned website found; other results were third-party directories (zmenu render was a JS shell with no extractable text, weeblyte.com and res-menu.net are barred/unreliable per playbook). Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org Menu JSON-LD (server-rendered even though the store showed 'Closed now' at fetch time -- that is a store-hours state, not an absent menu). Address 9535 Mission Gorge Rd, Santee matches the work list exactly. Markup check against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.18/1.2/1.25/1.3 found no dominant divisor -- ordinary odd-cent menu pricing (many items already end in .95/.00 natively), not a uniform delivery surcharge. Sections: Appetizers, Soups Noodles & Rice, Salads, Nigiri Sushi (2 Pcs) [sashimi/nigiri], Special Rolls, Classic Rolls -- appears to be the restaurant's full sushi-bar menu (rolls, nigiri, apps, soups, salads all present).

name: The Noble Chef
notes: Work list had no website. Restaurant's own site not found; found instead a farm-style page (thenoblechef.restaurants-us.com) that self-discloses 'This is not an official website. Content updated by the community.' and priced nearly every shrimp dish identically at $28.95 (House Special Shrimp, Pepper Garlic Shrimp, Pan Fried Shrimp, etc. all $28.95) -- a uniform-price tell, discarded as unreliable rather than used or blended. Used allmenus.com's embedded schema.org Menu JSON (server-rendered, address 6159 Balboa Avenue / 92111 confirmed in page title/meta though the JSON-LD's own address block was blank) as the primary source: 17 sections, 195 priced items. Cross-checked against DoorDash's marketplace JSON-LD (also server-rendered, address not in its Restaurant block but title/content confirm the restaurant) for the 7 sections DoorDash carries (Appetizer, Soup, Fried Rice & Rice, Chow Mein or Chow Fun, Seafood, Beef, Chicken) -- every spot-checked overlapping dish matched allmenus to the cent (House Special Shrimp $19.95, Pan Fried Shrimp $17.95, Honey Walnut Shrimp $19.95, etc.), directly contradicting the farm site's $28.95 figures. No price was computed or adjusted from either source -- both were read as published. DoorDash is missing entire core sections (Pork, Lamb, Clay Pot, Sizzling, Vegetables, Tofu, Spicy Dishes, Abalone & Sea Cucumber, Chef's Specialties, Barbecued Dishes) that allmenus carries, so allmenus is the fuller and better source overall. Two items recur at different prices for different portion sizes on allmenus itself (Peking Duck $35.95 vs $38.00; Combination Platter $18.95 vs $38.95) -- kept both as separately listed, not merged or averaged.
